### What does this PR do?

Fixes `ToolAgentLoop.run` returning the prompt as the response when the first turn generates no tokens. Fixes #8478.

The final split is `response_ids = agent_data.prompt_ids[-len(agent_data.response_mask):]`. If the first generation is empty, `response_mask` is `[]` and the slice becomes `prompt_ids[-0:]`, which is the whole prompt. The loop does not crash: no tool calls are parsed, the state goes to TERMINATED, and the sample is emitted with `response_ids` equal to the prompt (cut to `response_length`), `response_mask` empty, and `prompt_ids` correct. After `_agent_loop_postprocess` the prompt tokens sit in the response region with `attention_mask=1` and `response_mask=0`, so the response is decoded and scored as prompt text and the prompt is counted in response length metrics.

Empty generations are produced by existing code paths: `vllm_async_server.py` returns `TokenOutput(token_ids=[], stop_reason="aborted")` when a request is aborted before its first token (`pause_generation(abort)`) or rejected at the weight sync gate, and `trtllm_async_server.py` does the same on rejection. #6675 already handled empty token lists in `_pad_token_ids` for this case.

`SingleTurnAgentLoop` already guards the same slice (`... if response_mask else []`, `single_turn_agent_loop.py:91`). This PR applies the same guard to `ToolAgentLoop`.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs. Paste at least one query link here: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+tool_agent_loop+empty and https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+empty+response+tool+agent+loop
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}` (This will be checked by the CI)

Not a duplicate: no open or closed PR or issue reports this slice. I also checked the diffs of the open PRs that touch `tool_agent_loop.py` (#8463, #8468, #8341) and none of them change this line.

### Test

Added `tests/experimental/agent_loop/test_tool_agent_loop_empty_response_on_cpu.py`. It runs the real `run()`, pending and generating states and the Continuous Token merge, with a stub server that returns a fixed `TokenOutput`:

- empty first turn (`token_ids=[]`, `log_probs=None`, `stop_reason="aborted"`): prompt stays the prompt, response ids/mask are empty, logprobs are `None`.
- normal first turn: prompt and response split as before.

```
python -m pytest -q tests/experimental/agent_loop/test_tool_agent_loop_empty_response_on_cpu.py
# main:      1 failed, 1 passed  (assert [11, 12, 13, 14, 15] == [])
# this PR:   2 passed
```

Related CPU tests, all passing on this branch (234 passed):

```
python -m pytest -q tests/experimental/agent_loop/test_audio_server_contract_on_cpu.py tests/experimental/agent_loop/test_call_tool_on_cpu.py tests/experimental/agent_loop/test_tool_agent_loop_empty_response_on_cpu.py tests/experimental/agent_loop/test_tool_call_id_on_cpu.py tests/tools/test_function_tool_on_cpu.py tests/tools/test_mixed_tools_on_cpu.py tests/utils/test_continuous_token_on_cpu.py tests/utils/test_turn_separator_on_cpu.py
```

`pre-commit run` on the changed files: ruff, ruff format, mypy, license and test structure checks pass.

### API and Usage Example

No API change.

### Design & Code Changes

- `verl/experimental/agent_loop/tool_agent_loop.py`: return `[]` for `response_ids` when `response_mask` is empty, matching `SingleTurnAgentLoop`.
- New CPU regression test as above.

AI assistance was used in preparing this PR; I reviewed and tested every change.

- [x] Apply [pre-commit checks](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-linting-and-formatting): `pre-commit install && pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure --color=always` (run on the changed files)

- [x] Add unit or end-to-end test(s) to [the CI workflow](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/tree/main/.github/workflows) to cover all the code. The new test matches `tests/**/test_*_on_cpu.py` and runs in `cpu_unit_tests.yml`.

+# limitations under the License.
+"""CPU regression test: an empty first-turn generation must not turn the prompt into the response."""
+
+import asyncio
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from typing import Any
+
+from verl.experimental.agent_loop.tool_agent_loop import ToolAgentLoop
+from verl.utils.tokenizer.continuous_token import ContinuousTokenBuilder
+from verl.workers.rollout.replica import TokenOutput
+
+PROMPT_IDS = [11, 12, 13, 14, 15]
+
+
+class _FixedOutputServer:
+    def __init__(self, output: TokenOutput):
+        self.output = output
+
+    async def generate(self, request_id: str, *, prompt_ids: list[int], **kwargs: Any) -> TokenOutput:
+        del request_id, prompt_ids, kwargs
+        return self.output
+
+
+class _NoToolCallsParser:
+    stop_token_ids: list[int] = []
+
+    async def extract_tool_calls(self, response_ids: list[int], tools: list[Any]) -> tuple[str, list[Any]]:
+        del response_ids, tools
+        return "", []
+
+
+def _make_loop(output: TokenOutput, response_length: int = 8) -> ToolAgentLoop:
+    # Bypass __init__ (it needs a full trainer config); set only what run() reads.
+    loop = ToolAgentLoop.__new__(ToolAgentLoop)
+    loop.rollout_config = SimpleNamespace(full_determinism=False)
+    loop.processor = None
+    loop.mm_processor_kwargs = {}
+    loop.continuous_token_builder = ContinuousTokenBuilder(tokenizer=None)
+    loop.loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+    loop.server_manager = _FixedOutputServer(output)
+    loop.tool_parser = _NoToolCallsParser()
+    loop.tools = {}
+    loop.tool_schemas = []
+    loop.response_length = response_length
+    loop.max_assistant_turns = 0
+    loop.max_user_turns = 0
+    loop.max_parallel_calls = 1
+
+    async def ct_build_initial_tokens(messages, **kwargs):
+        del messages, kwargs
+        return list(PROMPT_IDS)
+
+    loop.ct_build_initial_tokens = ct_build_initial_tokens
+    return loop
+
+
+class TestToolAgentLoopEmptyResponseOnCpu(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
+    async def _run(self, output: TokenOutput):
+        loop = _make_loop(output)
+        return await loop.run(sampling_params={}, raw_prompt=[{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}])
+
+    async def test_empty_first_turn_keeps_prompt_out_of_response(self) -> None:
+        # vLLM returns this when a request is aborted before its first token.
+        result = await self._run(TokenOutput(token_ids=[], log_probs=None, stop_reason="aborted"))
+
+        assert result.prompt_ids == PROMPT_IDS
+        assert result.response_ids == []
+        assert result.response_mask == []
+        assert result.response_logprobs is None
+        assert result.num_turns == 2
+
+    async def test_non_empty_first_turn_splits_prompt_and_response(self) -> None:
+        result = await self._run(TokenOutput(token_ids=[21, 22, 23], log_probs=[-0.1, -0.2, -0.3]))
+
+        assert result.prompt_ids == PROMPT_IDS
+        assert result.response_ids == [21, 22, 23]
+        assert result.response_mask == [1, 1, 1]
+        assert result.response_logprobs == [-0.1, -0.2, -0.3]
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

                 logger.error(f"Invalid state: {state}")

-        response_ids = agent_data.prompt_ids[-len(agent_data.response_mask) :]
